rows.known_text: I heard that he couldn't reach the top
rows.target_text: 頂上に行けなかったって聞いた

rows.known_text: I heard that he felt like talking
rows.target_text: 話したそうだったって聞いた

rows.known_text: I heard that he's going to be late
a few days ago I heard that he's injured
rows.target_text: 数日前ケガしてるって聞いた

rows.known_text: I wanted to send a message because I heard that he's injured
rows.target_text: ケガしてるって聞いたからメッセージ送りたかった

rows.known_text: I'm not going to wait because I heard that he's going to be late
rows.target_text: 遅れそうって聞いたから待たない

rows.known_text: I couldn't go because I heard that it was terrible
rows.target_text: ひどかったって聞いたから行けなかった

rows.known_text: I didn't need to ask because I heard that he was busy
rows.target_text: 忙しかったって聞いたから聞く必要なかった

rows.known_text: I didn't want to know because I heard that he's badly injured
rows.target_text: ひどくケガしてるって聞いたから知りたくなかった

rows.known_text: a week ago I heard that he needs to move house
rows.target_text: 一週間前引っ越す必要があるって聞いた
